title: Beliefs about consciousness can be explained without phenomenal properties

statements.text: It is widely accepted, even by anti-physicalists, that behavior and the mental processes that cause it, including assertions and beliefs about conscious experience, can be explained without non-physical properties. Zombies would make the same assertions. So these beliefs give no evidence for phenomenal realism, and it is reasonable to regard them as mistaken.

sources.quote: our claims and beliefs about consciousness afford no evidence for the truth of phenomenal realism
